name: sistemele
description: Don't ask your agent to reinvent the wheel: a practical starter kit and admin panel for AI-native projects on Cloudflare Workers. D1, CRM with leads and pipeline stages, catalog and stock, quotes, invoices, website and blog, dashboard and MCP.

DB.description: D1 database for all data. Migrations run on every deploy.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Your email. It becomes the owner when you first sign in at `/app/login`. Comma-separate several.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: [Resend](https://resend.com/api-keys) API key for sign-in links. Until you verify a domain, email only reaches your Resend account's address.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:demo: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=demo npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env demo
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
